title: E07-v1 renewal stage: donor copies (an inheritance route) with an isolated threshold-finding set, on cue-written discs
status: PROPOSED 2026-11-13; not registered. No engine run belongs to it until the lead registers it.
user_decision: option (c), 13 November 2026: donor copies as the main route, plus isolated newcomers with fast junction formation as a boundary set

decisions.D133: E07-v1's first choices (isolated newcomers at their own steady state)
decisions.D139: 'inherit' excluded; donor copies are an inheritance route, labelled as such
decisions.D144: validation drivers and protocols hold the experiment's choices; no engine change
decisions.D147: the sheets have no free field offsets; definitions are built through validation/tissue/field_solver_choice.declare() (auto: version 2)
decisions.composite_v2_decision_4: settled for donor copies in docs/E07_V1_DESIGN.md section 2: the slot's declared impermeant content, which equals the donor's in these worlds

engine_model: resolved_pump_replacement@1 (resolved_pump_composite@1 with scheduled_cell_replacement@1 over resolved_pump_tissue@3; junction formation delayed_first_order_junction_formation@1)

drivers.engine_runs: to be written after registration, reusing validation/tissue/heredity_turnover_literature.py's Stepper, run_segments, analyse and summary parts; it reads its arms and schedules from e07_v1_turnover.py

world.sheet: heredity_pilot.long_sheet_definition's 127-cell held-bath sheet without its cue populations (availability 0 after the cue): E07 voltage-gated junctions at coupling scale s, homogeneous heredity cells, ionic background
world.discs: the five that held 70 min without turnover in sheet70: 37 cells at s 1.0, 0.6 and 0.3; 19 cells at s 0.6 and 0.3
world.start: sheet70's state at 120 s (2 min after cue off), declared as the initial state; every ledger starts at zero; time 0 is sheet70's 120 s
world.volume: fixed (replacement over water waits for composite v2 section 2)

numerics.dt_basis: the pre-screen's check (numerics/verdict.json of heredity-turnover-literature-20261111-01): 5 ms against 1 ms within 9 uV and 2.3e-6 (amounts), identical D sets; outside G2-Q1's 1 ms scope, hence item E1
numerics.checks: the model's checked_step and device row checks on every accepted row
numerics.hardware: CPU, one world per process, one thread, memory-capped unit (6G)

replacement.order: oldest first: a seeded permutation orders the founders; each slot is then replaced every R, events at (j + 1/2) R / N on the dt grid

donor_rule.a: a junction neighbour of the slot, drawn uniformly and blind to its state
donor_rule.b: none: the isolated H template (the sheet's declared H state)
donor_rule.c: a disc neighbour of the slot, drawn uniformly (control)

replacement.seeds: replicate r: permutation from numpy default_rng([20261113, 0, r]); donors, one per event in event order, from default_rng([20261113, 1, r])
replacement.newcomer_content: donor copies: the donor's amounts of every species and channel gates (by law) at the event time; the slot's routes, volume and fixed-charge background; junctions restart the formation law (A0 0, law_open); no junction state is carried (D139). The driver checks every donor's P equals the slot's declared P
replacement.residence: R = k (lag + tau), k = 1: 1020 s (fast) or 2400 s (central); (b) R 1020 s
replacement.run_length: 2 R + 300 s (two full turnovers plus 5 min)

fast.basis: the division-born fast arm (Boassa 2010; design note G2 section 1.2), the literature ranges' lower ends

threshold_finding.label: threshold-finding: below the literature's 15-60 min; the 40 s point was seen only after the pre-screen's predictions were frozen; it tests no literature value

stop_rules: all H: one minute after the first of two consecutive 10 s records with no D cell anywhere in the sheet (absorbing)
censor: the first record with osmotic excess above 15% against the H start in any cell
refusal: a step the model refuses, or a failed device check on any row

null.definition: labels copied along each run's own schedule and donor draws; a newcomer takes its donor's label at the event time (read before any event at that time), or H when isolated; records every 10 s, each before any event at its own time
null.checked: on the pre-screen's own events, identical to the engine's J series at every record wherever the engine lost no D carrier and converted no newcomer

E1.name: numerics gate, before any judged arm
E1.method: the pre-screen's 1 ms / 5 ms comparison on E07-v1's own definitions: (a) fast at 37 cells, s 1.0, seed 1, the first 600 s; (b) tau 40 s at 37 cells, s 0.6, seed 1, the first 300 s
E1.criteria: heredity-turnover-literature-20261111-01/numerics/criteria.json: no refusal; identical D sets outside 1 s of a state change, every change within 1 s; |dVm| <= 1 mV outside those windows; amounts and osmotic excess within 1e-4
E1.outcome: pass: the arms run at 5 ms; fail: at 1 ms with the minimal set

E2.name: validity
criteria: no refusal and no failed device check in any judged run
every definition passes the driver's checks: P equality, D147 declare(), a layout equal to sheet70's
a censored run is reported as censored, with its outcome truncated at the censor

E3.name: (a) copying fidelity per coupling s, pooled over discs and seeds
E3.readouts: dJ(t) = J_engine(t) - J_null(t) for the same draws, at every record and at both turnover completions; the D-loss fraction (D copies lost to H before their own replacement); the recruitment fraction (H copies converted to D); founders lost before replacement; each split by D neighbours at arrival

classes.neutral_copying: mean dJ after the second turnover within +-delta, D-loss <= 2% and recruitment <= 2%
classes.electrical_erosion: mean dJ after the second turnover < -delta, or D-loss > 5%
classes.electrical_recruitment: mean dJ after the second turnover > +delta, or recruitment > 5%

E4.name: (c) control: disc slots, disc donors
E4.criterion: J = 1 at every record, no D copy and no founder lost (copying gives 1 by construction); any loss is reported with its time and neighbourhood

E5.name: (b) threshold-finding (reported, no pass or fail)
E5.readouts: per tau and s: isolated newcomers converted, as a fraction of those arriving with five or more D neighbours; dJ against the null (0 once every founder is replaced); tau*, the largest ladder tau with at least one converted interior newcomer

B1.name: J >= 0.8 through two turnovers
B1.role: reported for every run beside the null's P(B1); copying alone cannot pass it in (a) (0 of 2000 seeds), so it does not decide the outcome

bases: the literature-rule pre-screen (heredity-turnover-literature-20261111-01): summary.json, opportunity.json, the 1 ms / 5 ms check
the stress segment N2 (lag 10 s, tau 40 s, s 0.6): interior isolated newcomers converted at A 0.59-0.68 with six D founder neighbours (seen after the pre-screen's predictions were frozen)
predictions.E1: passes (differences about 10 uV and 3e-6 or less)
predictions.E2: no refusal, no failed device check; fast runs reach about 8% excess (no flag); central runs flag at 55-58 min after the cue and reach 14-15%; the censor may cut the last minutes of some central runs

E3.s0.3: neutral copying: dJ = 0 at every record in at least 7 of 8 runs; no D copy lost, no H copy converted
E3.s0.6: neutral copying: mean dJ after the second turnover within +-delta; D-loss <= 2%; recruitment 0
E3.s1.0: electrical erosion: mean dJ after the second turnover from -0.35 to -0.05; D-loss 5-25%; 5-20 founders lost per run; recruitment 0; the sheet all H in at most 1 of the 4 fast seeds; central runs within the same ranges
E3.recruitment: no H copy converts at any s

E4.s1.0: J >= 0.9 after the second turnover, no collective loss (low confidence)

E5.s0.6: recruitment of interior isolated newcomers falls with tau: >= 40% of those arriving with five or more D neighbours at 40 s, >= 20% at 120 s, <= 20% at 300 s; tau* >= 120 s, most likely 300 s; J after the first turnover 0.15-0.5 at 40 s and 0-0.2 at 300 s
E5.s1.0: all H within the first turnover at every tau (collective loss); recruitment, if any, only at 40 s and early

predictions.B1: fails in every (a) and (b) run; passes in (c) at s 0.6

budget.cost: 7.7 ms per step with two processes (the pre-screen): a fast run about 60 min, a central run about 131 min of wall time
budget.proposed: 32 runs, about 37 core-hours: about 18.5 h on two cores
budget.minimal: (a) fast seeds 1-2, (a) central seed 1, (b) at s 0.6 only, (c): about 19 core-hours, about 10 h on two cores

exclusions: water and volume (composite v2 section 2, held until S3's fix and first round land)
the full 825-node tissue (needs GH200 or a long-time method)
heterogeneous worlds and per-newcomer parameter draws
literature-range formation for isolated newcomers (the pre-screen's 13 arms: none of 317 converted); not rerun
order: 1 design, null and this PROPOSED protocol on the agent's branch
2 review by the lead and the advisor; registration by the lead on main
3 the engine-run driver (validation only) and a dry run on non-registered seeds (r >= 101), development
5 the judged arms, once, from a clean snapshot of the registering commit
